exports.unitTests: tests/unit/administration-exports.test.ts decodes PDF text with pdf.js, checks the font is embedded only when needed, characters outside the font become ?, the font bytes match font-coverage.json, and the row budget shares (pdfRowShares).

browserReview.environment: Chromium against the isolated local server; account languages saved per combination in the fictional database
screens: Administration overview, activity, consumption, members, reports, billing, settings
browserReview.results: 40 screens: no horizontal overflow, no page error, no text below WCAG AA contrast by an in-page computed-color check (disabled and hidden content excluded). Controls reported without a name were inside closed <details> menus. Targets under 24 px are the activity table's reference links and the moved year calendar cells, which keep their data-table equivalent.
browserReview.keyboard: All tab stops on My documents show a focus ring in reading order; Enter on a destination card sets aria-pressed, moves focus to the form heading and updates "Next: …".

limits: No hosted CI, production data, physical device or real Auth0/provider qualification.
PDF characters outside the bundled Roboto coverage (for example CJK) are drawn as ?.
Deployed Worker memory and CPU for the embedded-font PDF path are not measured.
The preparer of a dispatch and connection countries are not modelled and are not shown or invented.

workerBundle.note: The Roboto font data and fontkit are bundled but initialized lazily, only for PDFs that need them.
